title: SPOT：面向深度强化学习的未来前瞻性解释框架
summary: SPOT是一种模型无关、基于采样的深度强化学习策略解释框架。通过采样动作并递归模拟后续状态，构建可解释的有限时域树，提供策略动作偏好及下游演化的经验表示。具有渐近恢复最可能动作的保证，并在SUMORL交通信号控制中展示应用。
summary_en: SPOT is a model-agnostic, sampling-based framework for interpreting deep reinforcement learning policies. It builds an interpretable finite-horizon tree by sampling actions and simulating successor states, providing empirical representation of policy preferences and downstream evolution, with formal guarantees and a traffic-signal control case study.
